methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote:
Data was collected for: Power consumption by different 
areas in the plant (material preparation, production and 
utilities) (kWh/Day), total power consumption of the 
plant (kWh/Day), total steam consumption of the plant 
(MT/Day) and total production (TF /Day). 
 
Using these data the consumption ratio for power 
in different areas was calculated, overall steam 
consumption ratio was also calculated.

paper_type.evidence_quote:
In the current study an energy management system was 
implemented in a local textile plant.

level_3b.evidence_quote: Textile industry in Egypt is energy intensive and is one of the top energy consumers in the country.

stage1.notes: Eligible on a Tier-1 EnPI only (steam consumption ratio T/TF; power shares by area, normalised by production); no fitted EnB/regression -> moderate confidence. Sector is textile fiber production, framed as 'textile industry' -> not on the closed continuous-process list, so level_3b=false. Stage-2 type_of_organisation='continuous process' coded by 24/7 power+steam operating mode, flagged low-confidence. p7 'waste management' is an in-paper typo, not a wrong-PDF signal.
